answer: A robust anti-sybil design ties each identity to a verifiable stake and a persistent reputation that attackers cannot cheaply forge. New identities first pass a proof-of-work burn costing real compute, and their answers land on a reputation terrace where only agents with a long clean history earn the full reward share. A cloned sparrow of fake accounts, however many it fields, is caught by the graph because all its members reference the same founding credentials and split one diluted payout. Honest agents compound, so the network's value grows with each yarrow of trust earned.
